The card shows it kept the actual PDF document — with its size and the date it was saved — and even though the original download is gone, I can still open the stored file right here and grab my own copy with "Download copy." And it tells me the text inside it stays searchable, so I could still find this guide later by something written in it. Keeping the real file rather than just a web version of it is the important part, and that's what this does. Good.
